definitions.explanation: An educational system where male and female students study together in the same institution. Short for {男女|だんじょ}{共学|きょうがく}.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共学|きょうがく}です。
⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{共学|きょうがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: It is scheduled to become coeducational starting next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧{共学|きょうがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わった→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧。
examples.english: After the war, many schools switched to coeducation.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the full form ⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧{共学|きょうがく}. The shortened form {共学|きょうがく} is common in casual speech. Used as a noun that can also modify other nouns (e.g., {共学|きょうがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧{共学|きょうがく} (coeducation)
- {共学|きょうがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧ (coeducational university)
- {共学|きょうがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become coeducational)
- {共学|きょうがく}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (becoming coeducational)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{男子校|だんしこう}→男子校：15311_danshikou⟧: boys' school
- ⟦{女子校|じょしこう}→女子校：22046_joshikou⟧: girls' school
- {別学|べつがく}: separate-gender education
